'''Combat Master''' was a title used by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] around [[3626 BBY]]. The [[Dar'manda]] member [[Bask Sunn]] was a combat master.

The title was held by [[Xat Hracken]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] instructor at a [[Odacer-Faustin Sith academy|Sith academy]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Odacer-Faustin]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
